floater.title: Wolf DJ / Talk Show

line_editor.name: stream_url
line_editor.tool_tip: Your stream from My Radio Stream on wolf-grid.com, e.g. http://cast.wolfterritories.org:8000/radio/your-name. Every region owner gets one free.

button.label: My Radio Stream...
button.name: get_stream
button.tool_tip: Open My Radio Stream on wolf-grid.com: make your stream, see its address and password.

button.label: Copy
button.name: copy_url
button.tool_tip: Copy your stream address, to give a region owner for their land's music.

line_editor.name: stream_password
line_editor.tool_tip: Your stream password (shown once on My Radio Stream). Kept in the viewer's encrypted store.

floater.text: Voice: what you hear in voice chat

slider.label: H
slider.name: eq_high_voice
slider.tool_tip: Treble (-24 to +12 dB). Double-click the knob to reset.

slider.label: M

slider.label: L
slider.name: eq_low_voice
slider.tool_tip: Bass (-24 to +12 dB). Double-click the knob to reset.

slider.name: fader_voice
slider.tool_tip: Fader: how loud this goes out on the stream.

panel.name: meter_voice
panel.tool_tip: Level: green is fine, amber is loud, red is too hot. The top LED lights when it clips.

button.label: Mute
button.name: mute_voice
button.tool_tip: Take this channel off the stream.

button.label: Cue

button.tool_tip: Listen to just this channel yourself (before its fader). Click again to stop.
